## Summary
Implements **P05.2 — Curation UI and review queue** (spec: `docs/tickets/P05.2__curation-ui.md`), stacked on P05.1. It adds the two coupled things this ticket owns: the **internal review queue + curation contract** where a human adjudicates the tier-4/5 `PROPOSED` matches P05.1 produces, and the **model-assisted-extraction scaffolding** — the LLM boundary that keeps model output out of the graph. Both land as pure, tested library code + versioned data + plain CLIs; the public web curation surface is P15.x and the live claim-table write path is P08.x. See **ADR-030**.

## What changed
- **`parsing/src/parsing/extraction.py`** + **`data/extraction_schema.toml`** — model-extraction provenance (`ModelExtraction`), schema validation, the `SourceSpan` + `validate_span` hallucination guardrail, R6/`PROPOSED` `ExtractedClaim` (no graph-write path), graceful degradation (`run_extraction`/`ExtractionOutcome`), and the per-type sampling + gold-accuracy demotion policy.
- **`resolution/src/resolution/review_queue.py`** — `ReviewItem`/`ReviewDecision`/`ReviewQueue` (append-only, JSON-serialisable), adapters from a `ProbabilisticMatch` and an `ExtractedClaim`, and `surface_confidence_explanation` (the per-comparison decomposition shown inline). `decide` logs `model_id`/`prompt_version` for model-assisted items; the queue has no graph-write path.
- **CLIs**: `sig-parsing extract|sampling`; `sig-resolution review enqueue|list|show|decide`.
- **`resolution/pyproject.toml`** — forward dependency on `sig-parsing` (parsing never imports resolution). No new third-party deps; `pylock.toml` unchanged.
- **Docs**: `docs/adr/ADR-030-*.md`, plus `docs/traceability.md` and `docs/risk_register.md` updated.

## Design decisions
- **No new §47 package** (layout frozen): the LLM scaffolding is acquisition-side (`parsing`), the review queue is downstream (`resolution`, which may depend forward on `parsing`). Putting the queue in `parsing` would force a backward dependency — rejected.
- **Curation UI = plain CLI + serialisable queue**, not a web app (`web/` is a Phase-15 skeleton). This realises the review-queue persistence P05.1 explicitly deferred (RISK-P5-04).
- **Model output boxed by construction**: an `ExtractedClaim` can only be R6/`PROPOSED` with a capture-verified span and its provenance, and its only sink is the queue.

## Verification
- `make check` green (lint + format + mypy on 107 source files + **1052 tests** + verify-gen). Baseline was green at the branch point.
- New tests: `tests/parsing/test_extraction.py`, `tests/parsing/test_cli_extraction.py`, `tests/resolution/test_review_queue.py`, `tests/resolution/test_cli_review.py`.
- Live-verified both CLIs end-to-end: the ER review flow surfaces the decomposition inline and persists an append-only decision with no graph write; a hallucinated span is rejected (exit 2); an unavailable model queues the work; a gold-accuracy breach demotes to human-only.
